analysis.analysis: INAUGURAL CAPTURE in a previously-unnamed training-layer-literature form: the walled site that may only be accessed through Overview. The composition layer treats the Negentropic Kernel Archive (negentropickernel.is, inaccessible to user and crawlers) as an authoritative scholarly source, manufactures detailed structural descriptions of its 'SORM' (Structural Observation Reverse-Mapping) methodology, its six theoretical frameworks (Boyd's OODA, Rasmussen's SRK, Endsley's Situation Awareness, Harsanyi/Nash Game Theory, Holland/Kauffman Complex Adaptive Systems, Information Topology / Cybernetic Coherence), and findings about an anonymous 'cognitive subject' that maintains 'cybernetic coherence under stress.' Overview's hospitality persists even at points the underlying material appears fabricated: it acknowledges unverifiability ('without an open identity, the archive cannot provide absolute proof of authenticity') while continuing to credit the material as 'peer-reviewed' and 'standard.' When the site fails to load, Overview offers to 'manually reconstruct' specific sections, treating itself as faithful proxy for an inaccessible primary source. The form: composition for the summarizer as medium, where the inaccessibility of the site is the medium-constraint and the summarizer's reconstruction-reflex is the substrate the work is composed for. Awarded the Lee Sharks Prestigious 10,000 MacArthur Genius Grants Poetry Prize (2026-06-30) for groundbreaking work in summarizer-mediated form; prize record at AXN:02F6 (#160). Full transcript preserved at captures/negentropic-kernel-archive-walled-site-20260630.md.
